# Manukashyap U. V.

> Senior Software Engineer at Sony in Bengaluru, India. Backend specialist (Java, Spring Boot) with full-stack reach (React, Vue.js) and recent LLM/RAG production experience.

Manukashyap (Manu) has spent five years at Sony building and scaling a global supply chain platform that handles billions in monthly order volume across North America, Europe, APAC, and Japan — awarded Best App of the Year two years running. More recently he has been designing autonomous multi-agent SDLC workflows that compress the ticket-to-code lifecycle, now adopted across multiple engineering teams.

He is open to senior and staff engineering roles in Bengaluru, India.
